summary: Verified Emergent managed push notification integration end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_push_integration.py. (1) POST /api/register-push: 401 when no bearer; 403 when body.user_id != caller; 500 with detail 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' when upstream integrations.emergentagent.com returns 401 for the placeholder key (confirmed in backend logs: 'HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized' on /api/v1/push/users/register). (2) Booking regression - push failures are fire-and-forget and NEVER block flow: customer creates COD booking, admin reassigns partner, partner navigates (en_route) -> arrived -> start (OTP) -> complete, and customer cancel - every state transition logs 'Push failed (non-blocking): 500: EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' but each HTTP endpoint still returns 200 quickly. Verified via /api/admin/bookings/{id} that status transitions persist correctly (assigned -> completed; and cancelled on a separate booking). (3) Partner /api/partner/dashboard reachable with push integration active. Frontend smoke: Expo web preview loads clean (no red screen); only informational console warnings 'expo-notifications: Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' (expected - web is a no-op by design in src/push.ts via Platform.OS === 'web' guard). Login with 9800000001 + OTP 1234 lands on home; tab-bookings navigates and renders list (tracking screen already proven in iteration_6). No crash from expo-notifications module scope setNotificationHandler / setNotificationChannelAsync - both are platform-gated. Deprecated packages detected: NONE added by this change (expo-notifications is the correct current package). Pre-existing (iteration_6) RN-web warnings still present (shadow*, useNativeDriver, props.pointerEvents) - unrelated to push.
action_items: NO BLOCKER. Push integration is production-ready pending real EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY at deploy. Current placeholder returns 500 on /register-push and non-blocking warnings on booking transitions - exactly as designed.

Reminder for main agent: Real push delivery (device_token -> FCM/APNs) can only be validated on a real-device native build (not Expo Go, not web). Add google-services.json / APNs cert via Expo EAS build config before QA on device.

Carry-over from iteration_6 (unchanged by push work): clean up RN-web deprecated style props (shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents) and gate Animated useNativeDriver with Platform.OS !== 'web'.
critical_code_review_comments: push.py send_push correctly handles the full SuprSend relay contract: $idempotency_key, 401 -> 500 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid', 5xx -> 502, soft codes (insufficient_credits/integration_disabled/daily_limit_reached) are logged and swallowed, idempotency_key_in_progress retries up to 3x with 3s backoff. Good.
notify_customer wraps send_push in try/except -> warnings.log only; booking flow therefore never blocks on push. Verified in logs under test load.
logic.push_timeline and routes_partner.accept schedule push via asyncio.create_task(notify_customer(...)) so the HTTP response returns before the upstream call even starts - optimal UX latency.
frontend src/push.ts correctly bails early on Platform.OS === 'web' and !Device.isDevice, and swallows all errors (optional). Permission is requested on every open per the Emergent playbook.

_layout.tsx wraps Notifications.setNotificationHandler / setNotificationChannelAsync in Platform.OS !== 'web' / 'android' guards at module scope - correct ordering so handlers exist before any push arrives, and web preview is unaffected.

Minor nit (non-blocking): push.py's httpx.AsyncClient is created at import time with the env value snapshot of EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY. If the key is rotated at runtime (future admin UI), the client won't pick it up without a restart. Acceptable for current deploy model.

success_rate.frontend: Smoke only - app loads, login OTP works, bookings tab renders, no red screen, no module-crash from expo-notifications on web

seed_data_creation: Tests create fresh TEST_push / TEST_push_life addresses on 9800000001 and 2 COD bookings (one cancelled, one driven to completed). No seeded production data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push integration lives at /app/backend/push.py (router + send_push + notify_customer) and /app/frontend/src/push.ts (device token registration). EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY in backend/.env is 'placeholder' - integrations.emergentagent.com returns 401 -> our API maps to 500 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid'. All timeline/booking transitions emit 'Push failed (non-blocking)' WARNINGS in backend logs - this is EXPECTED and the booking flow still returns 200. Real push delivery is only testable on an EAS native build (Android with google-services.json / iOS with APNs). To validate on device: deploy with the real EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY, run the app on a physical device (Device.isDevice must be true), accept notification permission, call POST /api/register-push -> expect 201 {status:'registered'}, then trigger any booking event and confirm the FCM/APNs push arrives.
rca_of_issue: No bugs. All acceptance criteria met.
